label: illustrative; validate locally
climate_source: NASA POWER cached historical daily climate; uniform illustrative shifts
grid_source: design choice, not empirical; validate locally
distance_rule: Euclidean distance in grid steps from 0 C and 0% rainfall; ties prefer smaller temperature change, then smaller absolute rainfall change
tie_rule: Use one fixed-seed permutation of exact feasible rotations to choose among exactly equal objective scores; baseline wins an exact tie with the best feasible rotation
seed_source: design choice, not empirical; validate locally

tipping_point.sentence: The top strategy first changes at +2 °C and +0% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from fallow → soybean → sorghum to fallow → soybean → pearl_millet.

The top strategy first changes at +0 °C and +10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from fallow → cereal_rye_cover → soybean to fallow → soybean → cereal_rye_cover.

The top strategy first changes at +0 °C and +10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from sorghum → soybean → sunflower to sorghum → sunflower → soybean.

The top strategy first changes at +1 °C and +10% rainfall (nearest grid cell in normalized steps from unchanged historical weather). The top rotation changes from fallow → soybean → sorghum to fallow → soybean → pearl_millet.

caveat: Uniform shifts to cached historical daily weather are a sensitivity stress test, not a climate projection. Crop calendars and soil storage stay fixed. Crop and irrigation inputs are illustrative; validate locally.
